title: PVL: Sisi Rondina eager for Cebu homecoming with family in the stands

blocks.text: CEBU CITY — In the Queen City of the South, Sisi Rondina makes her homecoming from the sands to indoor professional volleyball as Choco Mucho kicks off the Premier Volleyball League’s 10th anniversary on Saturday at SM Seaside Cebu Arena. Rondina, fresh from the Asian Games beach volleyball quarterfinals stint with Bernadeth Pons, is playing in her home province for the first time as a professional against Capital1. The former league MVP, who hails from Compostela, about an hour’s drive from Cebu City, will bring her family to watch as early as Friday. “My family will be watching. We’re only about […]...
